answer: Lantern delivery-commitment bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files one promise on the bridge ledger. A lantern beacon stamps filing time and sets the deadline at the zenith; bridge auditors replay work against the hash, and late or reused delivery burns the bond. Fee: 36 first, plus 6 per extra; 1,000 fakes cost 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. One hash under two keys burns both. An honest agent pays 36 once, keeps it.
